summary: Comprehensive testing of Stripe integration, public landing page, admin product management, and license system for AppCloud by Optio. All features working correctly: Public landing page with product info and purchase modal, Stripe checkout session creation, Admin CRUD operations for products, License management APIs, and Dashboard navigation.

backend: GET /api/products - Returns list of active products (1 product found)
POST /api/purchase/create-checkout - Creates Stripe checkout session successfully
GET /api/admin/products - Returns all products with sales_count
DELETE /api/admin/products/{id} - Deletes product (hard delete for products without orders)
frontend: Public landing page loads at '/' with hero section
'Get Your CloudNode' CTA button visible and clickable
Product price ($5,000) displayed on landing page
Features section visible (Passive Income, Lifetime License, etc.)
Sign In link visible and navigates to /login
Get Started link visible and navigates to /register
Purchase modal opens when clicking 'Get Your CloudNode'
Purchase modal has Full Name, Email, and Referral Code fields
Purchase modal shows product name and price ($5,000)
'Proceed to Payment' button visible in modal
Admin login works with admin@optio.com / admin123
Admin products page at /admin/products loads correctly
Products table shows CloudNode product with price and status
Add Product button opens create product modal
Create product modal has all required fields
User login works with user1@example.com / password123
User dashboard loads at /dashboard
Dashboard sidebar navigation items visible
Navigation links use /dashboard prefix correctly
App Marketplace navigation works (/dashboard/app-marketplace)

Default CloudNode product auto-seeded on startup at $5,000 with lifetime license

Admin product CRUD operations include audit logging

context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe integration fully tested. Key features: 1) Public landing page at '/' with product info and purchase modal. 2) POST /api/purchase/create-checkout creates Stripe checkout session. 3) Admin products page at /admin/products with full CRUD. 4) GET /api/licenses returns user licenses (auth required). 5) Dashboard sidebar shows 'My Licenses' section only when user has licenses. Test file: /app/tests/test_stripe_products_licenses.py. Note: To test full purchase flow, you would need to complete Stripe checkout which requires manual interaction with Stripe's hosted checkout page.
